profile.headline: Software Development, Architectural Design, Data processing & Migration

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer, Architectural Design, Contractor
positions.description:
VSP - Sacramento, CA
Sr. Developer in Healthcare. Mainframe migration, Service layer development, Architectural design, API Development, Service assurance, DB methodologies, Mainframe data processing. Technologies: Java, Splunk!, Corba, SQL.

Williams-Sonoma - Rocklin, CA
Full stack eCommerce development. Involved in software improvements, hardware / VM provisioning, online catalog content management tool upgrades, API end-point mapping, third-party product integration and bug resolution. UI development for six associated, customer facing, brands across mobile and desktop offerings. 
Involvement: Jira, Confluence, Eclipse, IntelliJ, VisualVM, Java 1.6-1.8, J2EE, Junit, Jetty, Spring, Struts, JSP, Freemarker, Adobe Experience Manager's (AEM) ECM, WCM, ES6 JS, NodeJS, JavaScript, Npm, Webpack, OSGi, JAAS, ExtJS, CSS, Sass, Oracle DB, JCR datastores, Jackrabbit Oak, Subversion, Github, ESI Akamai, Maven, Perl, Rundeck, Elasticsearch Logstash Kibana (ELK), Shell, Perl, Python,, Lucene, AppDynamics, Solr, MVC, DAO, Agile, Scrum.
•	Development in complete product life-cycle, root cause analysis, feature planning, architectural improvements and maintenance.
•	UI development in Node, ExtJS, ES6, JavaScript, Dojo, Freemarker, and webpack for web components.
•	Analytical assessments including application-based service profiling, thread and heap analysis with the purpose of identify bottlenecks to improve application use during high loads.
•	Customizations and migration for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) v6.0 - v6.4.
•	Application / hardware tuning achieved while communicating with end customers, DevOps, associated architects and VM resource managers.
•	CentOS / Linux management, Perl, Python, bash scripting paired with associated monitoring tools.
•	Processing, configuration, testing and displaying data from several integrated, rules-based, pricing, caching and legacy services.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer, Lead
positions.description:
Development / management in support of various product lines across the company’s offerings ranging from core deployable agents, APIs and full stack server side to front end solutions in an Agile environment. Co-managed team, scrum board and associated activities.
Involvement: Java, J2EE, ExtJS, jQuery, Jasmine JS Unit Testing, OOP PHP, PHP Unit Testing, Selenium, Sass, Compass, CSS, Maven, Junit Testing, Ant, Composer, MySQL, PowerShell, VB, RabbitMQ, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, IntelliJ, PHPStorm, Jasmine, Symfony, AWS, Amazon EC2, Rundeck, Docker, Vagrant, Backbone JS, Bootstrap, DataTables JS, d3JS, SVG, Node, Ruby, .NET, C#, REST, Google API, Outlook API, Github, SVN.
•	Resource during a migration from a PHP implementation requiring mid-tier improvement and cross framework integration with newly developed Java service layer designed to alleviate traffic from overextended dashboard resources.
•	Delivered updated business layer, OOP PHP improvements, and UI functionally in a distributed team across continents as a key element remotely working with UK, Canadian, Portuguese and American offices to achieve results. 
•	Dashboard UX redesign detailing a complete UI overhaul, prototypes and implementation.
•	Debugging AWS / Java microservice implementations requiring RabbitMQ MQTT, DynamoDB and Elasticsearch web services used to aggregate and receive data payloads from distributed agents on diverse platforms.
•	Full stack development including deliverables for distributed agents across different platforms.
 •	UI / UX front-end and business layer development through a home-grown JavaScript framework solution.
•	Contributions in architectural design and schema generated services utilized to drive UI layout, component behavior and portlet cross communication. 
•	ASP .NET, C# based API layer debugging to ensure data delivery.
•	Assessments and implementations in Backbone JS, Bootstrap, Knockout JS, jQuery, Angular JS, D3JS, Node, Compass, Ruby, ES5.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Part of a small team responsible for system integration with multiple third-party products to meet internal goals and provide end customers with valuable reporting on managed equipment and associated billing factors. Software principles and execution in DB schema, data migration, view manipulation, web development, business logic, business analysis and software architecture. Associated with critical deployment strategies, application health monitoring, software server and container migration as well as development / production environments upkeep. Involvement: Oracle SQL, SQL packages, SQL views, SQL stored procedures, JNDI, JDBC, Perl, Java, PHP, JSP, JSF, J2EE, Primefaces, CSS, JavaScript, Log4J, Maven, Ant, jQuery, YUI, DOJO, Tomcat, Unix, Linux, Windows, Eclipse, Toad, SQL Developer, SVN, XML, XSLT.
•	Delivered newly developed PrimeFaces / JSF UI to improve presentation and processing workflow.
•	Migrated Tomcat based application to Glassfish to allow app growth and service layer improvements.
•	Provided SQL and Perl scripts facilitating data migration during deployment between schemas.
•	Debugging and implementing Oracle based SQL stored procedure calls.
•	Assurance of data synching between web integrated applications.
•	Debugging faulty / lengthy data requests from both DB and web application.
•	Root cause analysis and reconstruction of errors by associating logged data to DB user sessions.
•	Maintenance of in-house OOP PHP based applications.
•	Web presentation of data after completion of front, business and backend beans modeling DAOs.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintenance and development of all in-house software products ranging from Financial, Project Management, HR systems to in home products utilized to fulfill and support the management team's productivity for internal and external projects. Work included MSSQL DB management, DB job maintenance, DB backups / restores, hardware upgrades, OS and network architecture maintenance.
Involvement: VMWare ESX, Java, PHP, Perl, ASP, .NET, VB, AJAX, JavaScript, XSLT, HTML, SQL, MS SQL on Windows, Linux (Ubuntu) and SunOS, network asset management and root cause server infiltration analysis.
•	On hand management with ESX 3.5 and ESXi 4 VMware instances as well as iSCSI targets and LUN manipulation. Assisting in prototyping for bidding projects and used as a resource for planning and architecture of corresponding implementations.
•	Corrected DB related issues preventing Changepoint product update by decrypting DLLs. Created associated guides and scripts for production upgrade and data migration.
•	Corrected and secured hacked websites associated with the business unit.

positions.title: Sr. Software Eng.
positions.description:
Team lead responsible for product delivery, organization of resources, technological assessments and staging deliverable commitments for a new product built on top of an already existing framework designed for network management. The product managed modeled services in a GUI intensive interface whose purpose was to calculate end client impact through root cause analysis by assessing service impact through pre & post processed propagated alerts. Involvement in beginning of the product included development of selling point to both internal and external members to the company, paper and software prototyping, presentations, POC (Proof of Concept) development, interviewing/hiring of new elements, training, project organization and full product development.
Involvement: Java, J2EE, Shell Scripts, Wicket, JSP, JSF, JBoss, JetSpeed, JavaScript, DHTML, AJAX, jQuery, Maven, Spring, Struts, SVN, Root Cause Analysis, Propagation Engines, Groovy, CSS, SaSS.
•	Managed local and India teams as portal lead during requirements gathering and product implementation.
•	Developed modules using AJAX / DWR on a Java based JSF / JBoss Portal platform.
•	Continued implementations on Wicket on top of a Tomcat based JetSpeed Portal deployment.
•	Created cross interactive portlets with dynamic web content updates, charting and a JS based interactions.
•	Created dynamic JavaScript and Canvas based cascading element tree to show severity propagation in models in parent / child relationship using AJAX and other web libs.
•	Involved in web architecture development, marketing and sales interfacing, QA interactions
•	Observed JSRs 168, 286 while managing expectations from customers, product management.
•	Using Rapid Development model using Planning Poker, Stories, Sprints and other tools.

positions.title: Sr. Software Eng.
positions.description:
California’s DCSS. (03/06-11/06)
The task was to quickly work with customer to provide a .NET portal solution that would allow dynamic content publishing to their site. After the requirement acquisition process, I was tasked as the primary developer in an effort to create and customize modules, skins as well as all associated services.
•	Managed MS SQL instance and connecting users associated with product developed
•	Crated DotNetNuke skins, portlet functionality with .NET’s C# and VB on IIS
•	Established communications with DTS for a collaborative effort. 
•	Online tutorials, web-casts, documentation, training sessions.

Java Developer, Fed Contract (08/06-12/07)
Member of a small team, ownership was assumed for a part of the product designed to visualize data from multiple sources
• Java Dev, core architectural work for the product.

California OHI Office. (10/05- 12/07)
The job called for technically diverse individuals that would cater to any possible need for the client. The work includes but is not limited to all phases of the web development process.
•	Was in charge of small web team with the purpose of migrating the CalOHI website from a JSP/HTML/Oracle8i solution to a .NET/ MS SQL & PHP/MySQL environment. Conducted customer requirement gathering sessions, analysis on Content Management Systems and Collaboration tools.
•	Conducted meetings with the California State web managers, DTS, and organized efforts with several organizations to meet the team’s technical objectives.
•	Stabilized web server services during data acquisition
•	Maintained/expanded Oracle tables, procedures and triggers.
•	Expanded functionality of report based acquisition by using CSS, and DHTML modules as well as Perl scripting in a UNIX environment.
•	Maintained CalOHI site using Teamsite web publishing in a BroadVision based environment.
•	Created instructional videos, web tutorials and custom graphics, Crystal reports.
•	Manage a small development team to meet objectives.

positions.title: Software Eng.
positions.description:
Involvement in the design, development, documentation, testing and support of several TCP/IP and SNMP based product lines. Was also responsible for product integration and data mapping modules for framework products. Had a chance to become a key member of a dynamic team by gaining and applying knowledge of new languages quickly to develop GUIs, APIs and other modules on demand.
•	Developed a highly interactive, real time web alarm interface in a portal environment using JSP, Java, Java Beans, CSS, XML, JDBC(SQL), JavaScript, DHTML and Apache Tomcat. Created APIs and associated modules to sustain session-based loggings.
•	Consulted and developed product enhancements for existing product lines, including the expansion of functionality for a Java-based SNMP Mib Browsing tool. Added Traps, Notification and Get/Set panels with command tracking through a historical based system.
•	Created database instances to mimic customer deployments. Created SQL VIEWS for Crystal Reports and utilized markup to check data propagation. 
•	Developed and maintained Unix Shell Scripts for installations, maintenance and upgrades of major product lines. Reduced customer involvement with installations and increased intelligence built within the scripts to create more focused and informative installations.
•	Learned internal proprietary software language and completed framework integration with an Access7 product to expand data availability, composition and presentation.
•	Prototyped several Java, HTML and DHTML based GUIs for the expansion of product lines.
•	Performed knowledge transfers within the organization for developed products and trained Technical Assistant members so they could do their job more efficiently.
•	Used C, C++, HTML, JavaScript, CSS and VRML in the creation of a 3D Network Topology tool that would be used to navigate and display real time alarm updates on objects displayed.
•	Used Perl in creating a web environment used for data collaboration in between teams.

volunteerExperiences.description:
A world wide community of volunteers gifting their time and resources to provide low cost 3D printed, upper limb prosthetic devices starting at a ~$45 price range. Our community generates open licensed prosthetic designs for anyone to use or improve upon. Involvement:Software Development, Software solution asset maintenance and application management, Internal Process Workflows, Technical guidance, Translator.
Community Blog Site: http://enablingthefuture.org/
